Game_Theory.title: Hey It's Me Souvlakity
Game_Theory.formula_used: Binary string ownership range evaluation; score = lastIndex('1') - firstIndex('1') for count >= 3, with base states for count <= 2

Game_Theory.problem_name: I Know About a Million Things
Game_Theory.title: I Know About a Million Things
Game_Theory.time_complexity: O(N) -> Pure byte-level custom parser. Zero reflection overhead.
Game_Theory.space_complexity: O(1) -> Absolute bare-metal. Slices bypassed entirely.
Game_Theory.formula_used: Parity state-space reduction; terminal losing states: (evens == 0 && odds == 3) || (evens == 1 && odds == 1)

Greedy.title: Floor of MEX (Easy Version)
Greedy.time_complexity: O(N) -> Constructive maximal subset using difference array.
Greedy.formula_used: diff[a_k * k]++, diff[min(n, (a_k+1)*k)]--; Maximal subset bypasses forbidden ranges

Greedy.title: Prefix
Greedy.time_complexity: O(N) -> State space collapse to tracking min/max prefix sums
Greedy.formula_used: s_new ∈ {a_i, s + a_i, 2s + a_i}; track only min_s and max_s

Math.title: Monocarp and Projects
Math.formula_used: (y + i) % (x + i) == (y - x) % (x + i); early termination with remaining * (y - x) when x + i > y - x

Math.title: KiaKio
Math.formula_used: Sum of digit squares cycle convergence followed by combinatorics sum(c * (c - 1) / 2) over equivalence classes

Math.title: Robot Odd Moves
Math.formula_used: if b > a+1 { -1 } else if a%2 == b%2 { a } else { a+1 }

Math.title: The Projections of Paco
Math.formula_used: pos = 2 * a_i - pos; solve for initial p giving final pos = 0

Math.title: In Search of Convenience
Math.formula_used: (x - x0)^2 + (y - y0)^2 = R^2; setting y = y0 simplifies to (x0 + R, y0)

Math.title: Perfect Sandwiches
Math.time_complexity: O(1) -> Pure mathematical derivation, zero loops.
Math.formula_used: min(b, a - b) if a > b else -1

Matrices.title: Min Matrices
Matrices.formula_used: Constructive matrix filling: diagonal mins i+1 for i < x where x = 2n - k, row/col mins for >= x, and sequential filler

Prefix_Sum.title: Subarrays
Prefix_Sum.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single pass with delayed mapping.
Prefix_Sum.space_complexity: O(N) -> Array allocations for prefixes and tracking counts.
Prefix_Sum.formula_used: prefix_sum[r] % k == prefix_sum[l-1] % k with a sliding delayed map (delay = k)

Sorting.title: Unrequited Love
Sorting.time_complexity: O(N log N) -> Standard sorting for frequency counting. Simple, clean, and cache-friendly.
Sorting.space_complexity: O(N) -> Single slice allocation, no map overhead.
Sorting.formula_used: Triad mapping v[i] = a[i] + a[i+2] - a[i+4], sorted frequency count sum(c * (c - 1) / 2) minus overlapping distance-2 and distance-4 pairs

Stacks.title: Did Not Go to Print
Stacks.formula_used: Monotonic stack simulation for document cancellation ('1' push, '2' pop/print, '3' print)

Strings.title: Replace and Compress
Strings.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single pass string scan. Zero actual compression simulations.
Strings.space_complexity: O(N) -> To store the string in memory, optimal for 3*10^5 constraints.
Strings.formula_used: String invariance scan: total unique lengths = 1 + canIncrease (if s[i-1]==s[i]==s[i+1]) + canDecrease (if s[i-1]!=s[i]!=s[i+1])

Two_Pointers.title: Rumb Needs a Hand
Two_Pointers.time_complexity: O(N) -> Single inward pass using two pointers.
Two_Pointers.space_complexity: O(N) -> Array storage, O(1) auxiliary space.
Two_Pointers.formula_used: Symmetric matching for misplaced elements: p[left] == right && p[right] == left
